definitions.gloss: general; broad; sweeping; comprehensive in outline
definitions.explanation: Covering the main points without going into detail. Describes an overview or summary that captures the big picture rather than specifics.

examples.japanese: {概括的|がいかつてき}な{説明|せつめい}。
まず{概括的|がいかつてき}に{述|の}べてから、{詳細|しょうさい}に{入|はい}ります。
examples.english: I'll give a broad overview first, then go into the details.

examples.japanese: {報告書|ほうこくしょ}では{概括的|がいかつてき}な{傾向|けいこう}のみが{示|しめ}されており、{個別|こべつ}のデータは{含|ふく}まれていない。
examples.english: The report only shows general trends and does not include individual data.

notes:
Composed of {概括|がいかつ} (generalization; summarization) and {的|てき} (adjective suffix). Used in formal and academic contexts when describing something that covers main points without exhaustive detail.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {概括的|がいかつてき}な{説明|せつめい}: general explanation
- {概括的|がいかつてき}に{述|の}べる: to describe broadly
- {概括的|がいかつてき}な{理解|りかい}: broad understanding
- {概括的|がいかつてき}な{傾向|けいこう}: general trend

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {大|おお}まか: rough; approximate — more casual and everyday
- {包括的|ほうかつてき}: comprehensive; inclusive — emphasizes covering everything, not simplifying
- {総括的|そうかつてき}: summarizing; comprehensive — close synonym, emphasizes summation
- {大体|だいたい}の: rough; approximate — colloquial

REGISTER:
Formal. Common in academic papers, reports, presentations, and official documents.
